traceTitle: auth/DoA/doa-notification-creation.spec.ts:113 › Delegated Organisation - Notification Creation › Carol Clark (agent) creates for Plant Org 1 → contact and importer auto-populated from Plant Org 1
crossTypeNote: Cross-type evidence observed with a CHED-PP Plant-organisation fixture. CHED-P is a POAO application; this finding applies only the rendered delegated-authority mechanism and does not infer any POAO-specific journey detail.
journeySummary: Carol Clark creates and submits a CHED-PP notification for IPAFFS Plant Organisation 1. The review page records Carol as submitter while responsible-person, contact, organisation and importer data are populated from the represented client organisation.

visibilityOwnershipRules.rule: For an on-behalf-of notification, responsible-person/contact and importer data are taken from the represented client organisation.
Agent and importer are separate roles: Carol Clark is retained as notification submitter, while Plant Organisation 1 is the importer and Isabel Irwin is the responsible person.
